description: This file defines a Calendar API module with functions and types for managing calendar events and assessments, including creating, updating, deleting, and fetching events and assessments.

methods.name: getCalendarEvents
methods.description: Fetches calendar events and converts date strings to Date objects.

methods.name: createCalendarEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateCalendarEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by eventId.

methods.name: deleteCalendarEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by eventId.

methods.name: createAssessment
methods.description: Creates a new assessment with specified parameters.

methods.name: updateAssessment
methods.description: Updates an existing assessment identified by assessmentId.
